basic_info.description: Nestled between Eureka & Noe Valley, this 3 bed + den is a bright & spacious full-floor flat offering the ideal blend of charm, flexibility, & modern updates for today's lifestyle. Whether you're working remotely or commuting, transportation options are plentiful. Corporate shuttles stop at 18th and Castro, MUNI, and multiple bus lines are nearby!  Flooded with natural light, the home features an updated eat-in kitchen with new cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and large south- & west-facing windows. The elegant formal dining room is perfect for entertaining, with box-beamed ceilings, original built-ins, & a decorative fireplace. The generous living room includes period details and city views.  A spacious, updated bathroom & a bonus office/den make working from home easy & comfortable. Additional amenities include a large in unit laundry room with hookups, extra storage on the ground floor, and access to a shared garden/patio.  Conveniently located near Dolores & Collingwood Parks, enjoy the best of San Francisco!  With a Walk Score of 98 & Transit Score of 83, you're just minutes from all the Castro and Noe Valley has to offer coffee shops, restaurants, gyms, boutiques, dry cleaners, parks, & more. The perfect urban lifestyle awaits!
